description: Monitors euthyroid adults with growth hormone deficiency (GHD) who are initiating GH replacement therapy for the development of central hypothyroidism (CH). Initiates levothyroxine (L-T4) if free thyroxine (fT4) falls below the laboratory reference range; triggers include GHD patient starting GH replacement.
